description: Java is a language for writing computer programs. Start with a message, then add numbers and make simple choices. Use small examples about names, pencils and scores. Later lessons cover lists, reusable steps and objects that keep related data together. Follow the setup lesson to install the tools and run each program on your computer.
versionNote: Targets Java 25 (LTS, September 2025). Everything also runs on Java 21 except where a lesson marks a feature as newer.
whatYouWillLearn: Print messages and count with numbers
Make choices and repeat small steps
Group data in lists and objects
learningObjectives: Use if to make a simple choice

seo.title: Java Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn Java through short lessons on values, decisions, loops, methods and classes. Follow worked examples and practise each new idea.
